property_summary: For every admissible call, the callee contract must receive exactly the well-formed transferFrom(address,address,uint256) calldata specified by C; the mutant instead sends transfer(address,uint256)-selector calldata, so a recording counterparty observes the wrong selector / malformed call and the reference's rule is broken.
change_summary: Replace the transferFrom selector hash with a different selector, changing which external function is called for each token transferFrom.
